method: words right in raw OCR and wrong after the VLM (same alignment as tools/correction_analysis.py); category by rule: accent only = equal after removing diacritics; spelling modernized = equal after diacritics removed and ph/th/y/double consonants/ct/pt/gm/mn/h simplified; deleted/merged = no aligned word; other = the rest (still contains modernizations the rule misses, e.g. s->z, ae->ai)
